sv.title: Filmade sina attacker – tatueringen fäller honom
sv.summary: Tre nätter i augusti brann det och flög brandbomber mot en villa på Jägersro. Allt filmades, skulle det visa sig. Och materialet hittades hos en 37-åring från Malmö. Han binds till brotten tack vare sin tatuering.

en.title: Filmed their attackers – tattoo gives him away
en.summary: Three nights in August, there was a fire and firebombs were thrown at a villa in Jägersro. Everything was filmed, it turned out. And the footage was found on a 37-year-old man from Malmö. He is linked to the crimes thanks to his tattoo.
